# contained in location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containedInLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a location to a larger location that contains it; transitive. A spatial/topological specialization of the universal [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) spine.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) from [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) to [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for spatial/topological containment of any [`Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) in a larger one; transitive, a specialization of [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), and the property the [`locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) chain walks.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the strictly geographic place ladder when [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) (its Place-typed refinement) is meant, and avoid it for mere adjacency ([`gmeow:adjacentTo`](gmeow-adjacentTo.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) between Locations; [`gmeow:generalizesVia`](gmeow-generalizesVia.md) walks it during coarsening, and [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md) propagates through it.

- ex:office [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) ex:building.
